# Third-party icon sources

`android/app/src/main/java/androidx/compose/material/icons/` contains 40 selected Material icon source files from AndroidX Compose Material Icons Extended Android 1.7.6, copyright The Android Open Source Project, licensed under Apache License 2.0 (included here). Original copyright headers are retained.

Source archive:
https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/androidx/compose/material/material-icons-extended-android/1.7.6/material-icons-extended-android-1.7.6-sources.jar

Only the used sources are included to avoid shipping the entire extended icon library and to reduce build memory and APK size. Other dependencies remain managed by Gradle/npm with their upstream licenses.
